confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Beijing price levels for July 2026; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were inspected. Food and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Hotel and hostel rates are least certain given district, booking-channel, and summer-demand variation. Cocktail and wine glass were set as multiples of the beer anchor (about 5x and 4x) because direct knowledge of Beijing bar prices is weaker, so they carry extra uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a formula input. Anchors reflect general knowledge of Beijing price levels, positioned within the range of other large mainland Chinese tier-1 cities such as Shanghai and Guangzhou.
